turns.learner: Hello! I need English for my job. Can we practise he, she and it with -s?

planner.explanation: Task-based because B1 or above, partly secure or better, with a real-life goal; main method Formative Assessment & Feedback Loops because: Do the task, then feedback on one or two language errors.

turns.tutor:
Hello! Good plan: this is useful for work.

Our goal today: use the verb correctly after he, she and it when you talk about routines.

First, a quick start. Think of a colleague you know well. Write two short sentences about what this person does at work every day. Begin each sentence with "He" or "She".

I will look at your sentences, tell you what is working and what to change, and then we will go on from there.
